applicabilityBasis.summary: thBILL is an appreciating pooled-investment token. The token count remains fixed while redemption value changes with the NAV of Wellington ULTRA and Fidelity FILQ. Redemption settles in USDC or USDT, and holders have no claim on underlying fund units or securities. These features support a non-payment-token assessment without asserting that thBILL itself has an established legal securities classification or a fixed monetary-value redemption obligation.

genius.notes: Theo describes a fixed share of a managed investment pool and NAV-based stablecoin redemption. This review classifies the appreciating investment position as non-payment-token/not-applicable. Underlying fund holdings and pooled returns do not independently establish that thBILL itself is a legally recognized fund unit or security. The legal securities classification remains unconfirmed and is unnecessary to this payment-stablecoin perimeter assessment.
